content.value: A fitness analytics company records the daily Calorie intake (in Kcal) of users as (16) [CO3] follows:
i) Partition this data into three equal-frequency bins after sorting the values.
ii) Apply smoothing by bin means and show the resulting values for each bin.
iii) Explain how smoothing by bin boundaries differs from bin means. Which method would be more suitable for this dataset? Justify your answer.
iv) Apply min-max normalization to transform the value 3000 into the range [0 – 1].

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 4th Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2024
